This is an application seeking to quash the charge-sheet bearing Sessions Case No.95 of 2020 arising out of Crime No. 147 of 2020 registered with Police Station Chandrapur, for the offences punishable under Sections 376(m) (n), 354(d)(2), 325, 324, 504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code on merits as well as the settlement.
4. At the instance of report dated 13.05.2020 lodged by College girl aged 20 years, crime has been registered.
It is her case that at the relevant time, she was studying in final year in Bachelor of Commerce Course.
The applicant was neighbouring resident with whom she had friendly relations.
At the instance of applicant, on 28.11.2019 she went with him for a ride by his four wheeler.
She alleged that applicant took the applicant at secluded place, beat her and had forcible sexual intercourse without her consent.
After occurrence, she was left free, on which she returned to her house and feigned that she sustained injury by way of fall.
5. It is informant's case that after two months, again applicant called her, demanded sexual favours by threatening that he would make viral the objectionable video clip.
By giving such Kavita.
1-apl 672-23.odt threat
on two more occasions, the applicant has established sexual relationship till April-2020.
Since the things went unbearable, the informant stated the happenings to her parents and after few days, she has lodged the report.
6. The informant has appeared and filed affidavit stating that the matter has been settled and she do not want to prosecute the matter.

She stated that under misconception and influence of relatives,
she has lodged the report.
Hence, she has no objection.
Learned APP objected for quashing by submitting that the allegations are of serious nature about repetitive sexual intercourse.
7. Apart from settlement, we have examined the entire material on merits.
Learned counsel Shri.Vyas, primly submits that it is the case of consensual relations in between two adults.
We have been taken through the First Information Report and print out to of whats-app chat exchanged in between both.
As per informant's own case, both had intimate relationship and the first occurrence was dated 28.11.2019.

The informant though stated about sustaining injuries in the occurrence,
however, she never disclosed the things to her parents but, made a false plea that she Kavita.
1-apl 672-23.odt felled from stair case.

The informant stated about further repeated act, however,
she did not lodge the report with the police.
It reveals that though first incident was dated 28.11.2019, for next six months there was no report.
8. We have been taken through the print outs of several whats-app chat to impress that after alleged first occurrence also, they were in relationship.
In in this regard, our attention is invited to chat dated 23rd December wherein the informant expressed her love to the applicant.
Likewise, they were in contact in the month of October and till the month of May 2020.
Prima facie it is evident that despite alleged occurrence dated 28.11.2019, both were in love relationship which is a matter of suspicion.

2 9.
The informant is well grown up college going girl having full understanding.
Though she stated that in first occurrence, she sustained grave injury however, her act of concealing the things from her parents itself supports the defence version about consensual relations.
Moreover, the frequent communication discloses that they were in relationship till the lodging of report.
Kavita.
The informant's learned counsel would submit that the informant is of marriageable age.
Continuation of prosecution may adversely affect her marital prospects as well as job opportunities.
The same submission has been advanced by the accused.
Though, both of them stated about their personal inconveniences on account of pendency of prosecution, however, we have examined the prima case on merits.
While, dealing under Section 482 of the Code, we are well empowered to consider overall effect of all the circumstances brought on record.
It is evident that, there was love relationship between the couple and relations continued for long time.
The lady never ventilated her grievance till the things become worst.
From entire occurrence the strong possible of consensual relations would surface.
Besides that, there is strong possibility that the informant would not support the prosecution case in trial on account of settlement.

Taking overall view of the matter, it reveals that it is the case of consensual relationship between two adults and therefore, continuation of prosecution amounts to abuse of the process of the Court.
Kavita.
In view of above, the application is allowed.

We, hereby quash and set aside the charge-sheet bearing Sessions Case No.95 of 2020 arising out of Crime No.147 of 2020 registered with Police Station Chandrapur, for the offences punishable under Sections 376(m)(n), 354(d)(2),325,324,504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.
